metadata.title: Lo-Fi Nocturnal Portrait with Light Leak

recipe.visualDefinition: A low-light, grainy portrait of a figure in a checkered garment, partially obscured by long hair and shadow, featuring a prominent vertical blue light leak on the right edge and heavy film grain throughout.
coreVisualRelationships: The vertical blue light leak acts as a vibrant counterpoint to the muted, dark olive and brown tones of the background.
The figure's pose creates a central vertical axis that is slightly offset by the light leak.
Heavy film grain unifies the subject and the negative space into a single textured plane.
coreInvariants: Vertical blue light leak on the right third
Muted, desaturated color palette in the shadows

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The subject is positioned in the lower center-left, occupying approximately one-third of the vertical height.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bright blue vertical light leak on the right edge.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the blue flare, moves left to the figure's arm and hair, then settles into the dark, textured negative space above.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Dominant upper two-thirds of the frame, filled with dark, grainy texture.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Cream and black (checkered pattern on clothing)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High contrast between the saturated blue flare and the extremely desaturated, low-value surroundings.
paletteRestrictions: Limit highlights to the light leak area

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single utilitarian block font to contrast with the organic, messy image texture.

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary condensed weight and blocky feel.
Clean, utilitarian aesthetic for metadata blocks.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a low-light, grainy photo of a person in a checkered dress standing in a dark field at night. Add a heavy vertical blue light leak on the right edge. The image should have high film grain and muted colors.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Place a small, rectangular black-and-white advisory-style block in the bottom right corner using a condensed sans-serif font.

verificationChecks: Is the grain texture consistent across the whole image?
Is the blue flare sufficiently saturated compared to the rest of the image?
Is the subject's face partially obscured by hair or shadow?

adjustableVariables: Intensity of the blue light leak
Amount of negative space at the top
mustRedesign: Specific facial features to ensure anonymity/mood
Any recognizable brand logos on clothing
postGenerationChecks: Check for 'digital' smoothness; add noise if necessary.
Ensure the blue flare doesn't look like a solid shape but a light bleed.
Verify the checkered pattern is visible but muted.
Confirm the top half of the image remains mostly dark negative space.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [Nocturnal Subject] + [Heavy Film Grain] + [Vertical Color Light Leak] + [Small Corner Metadata Block].
